data_stream_count.description: The count of data streams currently being managed by the data stream lifecycle.

data_streams.description: Information about the data streams that are managed by the data stream lifecycle.

last_run_duration_in_millis.description: The duration of the last data stream lifecycle execution.

time_between_starts_in_millis.description:
The time that passed between the start of the last two data stream lifecycle executions.
This value should amount approximately to `data_streams.lifecycle.poll_interval`.
